rooms.name: Tally Gate
rooms.instance_premise: A pressure lock with old tally cuts, a fresh cut, and a toll mouth beside the seam.
rooms.first_visit_description: Chorus, a rib lock blocks the seam. One wet toll mouth hangs beside a pressure pad grown into the floor. Old tally cuts close in dry scar. The fresh cut is still bleeding. When my boot settles on the pad, a sensing cord lifts and starts matching my pulse.

rooms.name: White Marrow Field
rooms.instance_premise: A cold marrow field where survey cuts, marrow lice, and step lanes make route obedience measurable.
rooms.first_visit_description: Chorus, the corridor opens into white marrow. The floor is hard enough to click under my boot and cold enough to stiffen the glove edge. Survey cuts cross it at regular intervals. Marrow lice keep the cuts clean by eating loose warmth. One lane fits my stride too closely.

corpus_influences.room_application: Write the marrow field as a readable cold record. Hymn should report cuts, lanes, lice behavior, and gait evidence before any larger conclusion.
